summary: Brinker International, Inc. filed an 8-K with Item 8.01 Other Events to announce the redemption of all its outstanding 8.250% Senior Notes due July 15, 2030. The redemption is set for July 15, 2026, at a price equal to 104.125% of principal plus accrued interest. No tender offer or exchange is involved; the company is exercising its call option. The notice of redemption was issued on June 16, 2026, and the form 8-K explicitly states it does not constitute a notice of redemption. This is a straightforward debt retirement, not a special situation, but it fits the issuer tender/redemption category. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory timeline beyond the redemption date is provided. The event removes the note overhang and reduces future interest expense; investors should monitor the redemption settlement and any subsequent refinancing plans.
